prompt:
Use case: identity-preserving graphic character design refinement.
Refine IMAGE 1, the gentle youthful silver-haired butterfly mage girl, using the same successful design workflow as this game's female archer and female dao fighter: coherent compact proportions -> intentional thematic silhouette and costume construction -> strict reduction of repeated motifs -> precise pose/anatomy cleanup. Deliver ONE finished improved full-body version of IMAGE 1.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 = ONLY identity, age impression, butterfly theme, outfit coverage, violet/silver palette and gentle girlish personality to preserve.
Image 2 = project archer's clean large color groups, intentional thematic silhouette, restrained placement of motifs and readable costume construction.
Image 3 = project's approved dao fighter visual standard: bold controlled contours, a few broad coherent shadow masses, expressive readable three-quarter silhouette.
Image 4 = project gem icon painting style.
Borrow drawing economy and design coherence from images 2–4, NOT adult feminine body curves, mature sultry faces, weapons, clothing, hair, colors or aggressive attitude. Image 1 must remain the same sweet youthful chibi girl, modestly dressed and nonsexual.

CHARACTER / PROPORTION LOCK:
Preserve silver-white flowing hair, two gracefully curved dark-violet horns with purple inlays, pointed elf ears, kind lavender eyes and a tiny gentle smile, small violet forehead jewel, modest dark-purple butterfly dress with covered collar/torso, white front panel, opaque purple tights and small ankle boots. Preserve the large youthful head and softly rounded face; refine the compact figure to roughly 3.5 actual head heights from crown to soles EXCLUDING horns, retaining short neat limbs and natural slim cartoon volume. Keep outfit fully opaque with knee-length skirt and intact tights, no bare midriff/cleavage or adult body sculpting.

MAIN IMPROVEMENT — THE BUTTERFLY IS THE WHOLE DESIGN LANGUAGE:
Build an unmistakable soft four-lobed butterfly silhouette out of her TWO WIDE SLEEVES, each sleeve with a large rounded upper lobe and a smaller gently rounded lower lobe. The two sleeves are real continuous pieces of clothing, attached naturally at shoulders and upper arms and extending to clearly defined cuffs near the hands; no detached wings growing from her back, no duplicate extra sleeve or disconnected panel. They softly spread downward beside the body like original butterfly robes, not stiff cardboard insect wings. Keep clear silhouette gaps between silver hair and purple sleeve edges.
Near sleeve slightly lifted by a small hand near the upper waist, opposite sleeve allowed to drape lower, creating a delicate asymmetrical butterfly arc. Keep BOTH wing shapes fully readable, never shrink/remove the butterfly in pursuit of simplicity.
Use ONE LARGE continuous pale-cyan/lavender curving wing pattern on each sleeve, like a stylized butterfly eye/teardrop band nested inside the wing, with 2–3 broad shapes total per side. No repeated small petals, scallop rows, feather scales or many narrow rays. Let rounded butterfly curves echo only in the sleeve lobes, two short hem panels and horn curves. Do not decorate every material.

COSTUME / HAIR ECONOMY:
Make the high collar, shoulders and torso a few quiet connected dark-violet cloth shapes. Consolidate the tangled gold chest lattice into ONE elegant continuous dull-gold collar/lapel border and ONE small central purple diamond clasp. The white dress front becomes one clean rounded taper with a SINGLE subtle purple butterfly-mark near its lower half, not a chain of repeated diamonds. Quiet skirt and tights, no repeating geometric leg markings. Simple boots with one gold edge.
Silver hair in ONE main back mass plus THREE broad flowing locks, with large clean lavender shadows, no dozens of little facet shards. Reduce hair mass slightly where it obscures the far butterfly sleeve. Horns retain the same paired recognizable profile but smooth their contour, with just 2–3 large purple shades each, no new crown detail.
Concentrate fine accents ONLY at the face/forehead and the central collar clasp; wing shape/pattern is the main large thematic feature. Maintain generous areas of quiet color like the female archer.

POSE / PERSONALITY:
Clear three-quarter LEFT for face, chest, hips and both boots, around 40–45 degrees, with visible natural foreshortening on far eye/shoulder. Shoulders relaxed, head subtly inclined, small warm smile, kind simple lavender cartoon eyes and gently curved brows. A composed delicate girlish idle standing pose: weight on one leg, other knee softly relaxed and foot a little behind/to side, feet close but separated by a visible narrow gap, both boots clearly visible and planted on the same ground level. Do not cross/merge the legs. One hand loosely gathers the near cuff near upper waist; the other lightly holds the lower opposite sleeve edge at her side. Both hands have believable thumb/finger contact and continuous connection through cuffs to the forearms. No fists, claw casting, wide battle squat, dance or pin-up posture.

PAINT:
Match the NEW female archer/dao samples' clean hand-painted game icon finish. Controlled thick dark-violet outside outline, much fewer inner outlines, 2–3 BROAD coherent matte color/shadow planes per material, sparse broad brushwork. Rounded skin shading, simple eyes, no realistic iris or shiny anime skin. No dense tiny polygon mosaics, glossy jewels, glitter, extra accessories or loose particles. Strong clear silhouette, large intentional shapes and restrained motif placement should be visibly improved from image 1.
One complete figure only, square canvas, warm uniform ivory #F4EFDF background. Full horns, sleeves, hair and boots fit with about 7–8 percent safe margin; no frame, inset rectangle, checkerboard, ground shadow, scenery, weapons, text, watermark or comparison sheet.
purpose: Apply the September 13 female archer and dao-fighter refinement workflow while preserving requested gentle youthful butterfly character.
visual_review: Butterfly silhouette retained, chest gold lattice replaced with a clearer collar/clasp arrangement, leg motifs removed and hair/clothing shadows grouped more broadly. Gentle youthful expression and modest outfit retained; hands and full feet visible, three-quarter left standing pose, plain opaque review background.
